# Pally.gg triggers

## Campaign tip

Runs when someone tips you on one of your Pally.gg pages. Great for a thank-you message or an alert.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Campaign (page slug)** | Only run for one of your Pally pages: type the last part of its web address. Leave empty for all your pages. |
| **Include replayed alerts** | Tick to also run when you press "Replay Alert" in Pally.gg, which shows an old tip again. Untick to skip those. Starts as: `true`. |
| **Minimum amount** | The smallest amount that runs this. Example: 5 ignores anything under 5. Leave 0 to run for any amount. Amounts are not converted between currencies. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Maximum amount (0 = no limit)** | The biggest amount that runs this. Leave 0 for no upper limit. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Currencies** | Only run for these currencies. Type the short codes with commas, like "USD, EUR". Leave empty for every currency. |
| **Include test events** | Tick to also run for test events (made with a "send test" button). Untick to run only for real ones. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who tipped |
| `%amount%` | The amount as a number, like 5 or 12.5 |
| `%formattedAmount%` | The amount written nicely, like "$5.00" |
| `%message%` | Their message |
| `%campaignTitle%` | The name of your Pally page |
| `%campaignSlug%` | The last part of that page's web address |
| `%campaignUrl%` | The page's web link |
| `%tipNetAmount%` | What you get after fees |
| `%isReplay%` | True if this is an old tip shown again |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |

<small>Type id: `pally.campaignTip`</small>

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to Pally.gg. Handy for a quick "all good" message or to switch something on.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |

<small>Type id: `pally.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when Cuebot loses or ends its connection to Pally.gg. Handy to warn yourself that alerts have stopped.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |
| `%reason%` | Why the connection ended |

<small>Type id: `pally.disconnected`</small>
